2609.21465.title: OmniVChat: Synthesizing, Benchmarking, and Training for Native Audio-Visual Dialogue
2609.21465.paper_summary: We define OmniVChat (Omni Video Chat) as the task of native audio-visual dialogue between a user and an omni model. In OmniVChat, omni models directly and simultaneously receive audio and video from a user and return text. The user's query is embedded in the audio and video, without a separate text question, external captioning, or speech recognition. Direct audio-visual input reduces external latency and computation while preserving perceptual cues. However, research on OmniVChat faces two constraints: data availability and evaluation. Recordings of people using their own devices are scarce. Furthermore, a good reply often needs to account for the user's surroundings, facial expressions, and nearby objects, and such responses can be expressed in many different ways, making keyword matching unreliable for evaluating reply quality. Recent progress in agent systems and video generation makes generation for comprehension viable, which means using synthesized dialogues for training and evaluation. Therefore, we present OmniVChat-Studio, a multi-agent data engine for synthesizing single- and multi-turn audio-visual dialogues. We use synthesized dialogues to build OmniVChat-Bench, an evaluation benchmark that evaluates omni models' basic dialogue abilities across five ability categories. We also present OmniVChat-RL, a reinforcement learning reward design that jointly targets reply correctness, efficiency, and style in OmniVChat. Training Qwen3-Omni-Instruct with OmniVChat-RL on synthesized dialogues improves its performance on both OmniVChat-Bench and the human-recorded OmniVChat-Bench-Human. These gains validate the reward design and show transfer to real-world dialogues in training and evaluation.
2609.21465.paper_summary_zh: 我們將 OmniVChat（全方位視頻聊天）定義為用戶與全方位模型之間的原生視聽對話任務。在 OmniVChat 中，全方位模型直接並同時接收來自用戶的音頻和視頻並返回文本。用戶的查詢嵌入在音頻和視頻中，沒有單獨的文本問題、外部字幕或語音識別。直接的視聽輸入減少了外部延遲和計算，同時保留了感知線索。然而，OmniVChat 的研究面臨兩個限制：數據可用性和評估。使用自己設備的人的錄音非常稀缺。此外，一個好的回應通常需要考慮用戶的周圍環境、面部表情和附近物體，而這些回應可以用許多不同的方式表達，使關鍵字匹配在評估回應質量時不可靠。最近在代理系統和視頻生成方面的進展使得理解生成成為可能，這意味著使用合成對話進行訓練和評估。因此，我們提出了 OmniVChat-Studio，一個用於合成單輪和多輪視聽對話的多代理數據引擎。我們使用合成對話來構建 OmniVChat-Bench，一個評估基準，用於評估全方位模型在五個能力類別中的基本對話能力。我們還提出了 OmniVChat-RL，一種強化學習獎勵設計，旨在共同針對 OmniVChat 中的回應正確性、效率和風格。使用 OmniVChat-RL 在合成對話上訓練 Qwen3-Omni-Instruct 改善了其在 OmniVChat-Bench 和人類錄製的 OmniVChat-Bench-Human 上的表現。這些增益驗證了獎勵設計並顯示了在訓練和評估中向現實世界對話的轉移。
